description: This PHP source file defines a trait `SubunitIdChainTrait` within the OrangeHRM PIM module. The trait provides functionality to retrieve a chain of subunit IDs related to a particular entity, using methods from an included service. It also handles the possibility of missing methods via exception.

methods.name: getSubunitIdChain
methods.description: Retrieves a chain of subunit IDs for the current entity, caching the result for subsequent calls. Throws a LogicException if the 'getSubunitId' method is not available.
